spans.s: SK0129 मूत्र mūtra One of the liquid form of Āhāra-mala. Urine. Function of Mūtra is to carry away Kleda (watery waste) from the body.
AF1299 मूत्र प्रकाशम् mūtra prakāśam Smell of urine
DG0178 मूत्र वर्ग mūtra varga Class of urine sourced from different animals.
AF1300 मूत्रगन्धि mūtragandhi Smell of Urine
AF1303 मूत्रतुल्यगन्ध mūtratulyagandha Smell of Urine
DG0180 मूत्रदशक mūtradaśaka Class of urine sourced from ten animals; sheep, Buffalo, Elephant, Camel, Goat, Horse, Donkey, Men, Women.
DG0181 मूत्रपञ्चक mūtrapañcaka Class of urine sourced from following five animals; Cow, Goat, Sheep, Donkey, Buffalo.
AF1301 मूत्रमार्गेण रक्तं mūtramārgeṇa raktaṁ Bleeding through urinary tract
DG0183 मूत्रविरजनीय mūtravirajanīya Urinary pigment restorers; substances used to impart normal color to the urine.
DG0184 मूत्रविरेचनीय mūtravirecanīya Diuretics; substances used to increase volume of urine.
DG0182 मूत्रसंग्रहणीय mūtrasaṁgrahaṇīya Ischuretics; substances used to reduce volume of urine.
AF1302 मूत्रस्रोतोरोध mūtrasrotorodha Obstruction of urinary passage
DG0179 मूत्राष्टक mūtrāṣṭaka Class of urine sourced from following Eight animals; Cow, sheep, Buffalo, Elephant, Camel, Horse, Donkey, Goat.
